title.intro: Monsters swarm in hordes. Survive each Chapter and defeat its King, collect EXP crystals to level up and pick new skills. Every skill fires on its own, so all you do is move and dodge.
title.keys:
WASD/ARROWS move
SPACE Ultimate when the gauge is full
P pause   M mute
Mobile: touch and drag to move

shop.note: Upgrades bought here last forever. Gold comes from monsters and boss chests, and goes to your wallet when you clear a stage or lose.

king.boss.arrive: Who dares interrupt my mirror time?!
king.boss.half: You scratched my perfect jelly! Unforgivable!
king.boss.escape: My skin! I need moisturiser! Bye!
king.bossD.arrive: Every grain of sand here is MINE. Pay up!
king.bossD.half: Do you know what that armour cost me?!
king.bossD.defeat: My gold... count it... for me...
king.bossC.arrive: A visitor! Nobody visits... please stay forever!
king.bossC.half: Don't go! Here, meet my friends!
king.bossC.defeat: Thank you... for playing... with me...
king.bossC.escape: Everyone always leaves... so will I.
king.umbra.arrive: So the little heroes finally came home.
king.umbra.half: The Heart is mine. Its shadow is me.
king.umbra.defeat: The light... it was always... there...

fx.lowFps: The game is running slowly. Lower the effects to keep it smooth?
title.tagline: Survive the horde. Defeat the Kings.
tip.move: Move with WASD / arrow keys (phone: touch and drag). Keep moving to dodge!
tip.auto: Your Skills fire on their own — you only move and dodge.
tip.crystals: Walk over EXP crystals to collect them and level up.
tip.levelup: Level up! Pick one: a new Skill, a stronger Skill or a passive.
tip.ult: Ultimate ready! Press SPACE (or the ULT button).
tip.king: The King is here. Defeat it before the timer ends or it escapes.
tip.stageEnd: Chapter clear! Check your build, then choose where to go next.
tip.combo: Combo! Different Skill elements on one monster make a bonus effect.
tip.bench: Your Bench grew: keep spare Skills there and swap them between Stages.
tip.bloodMoon: Blood Moon: many more monsters, double Gold and a bonus chest.
tip.dragon: A Guardian dragon is coming. Watch the red warnings and beat it to tame it!
tip.awaken: Awakening: fuse your finished Skill lines into one much stronger Skill.
tip.escape: Overtime! Kill the King soon — if it escapes, the final boss gets stronger.
coop.title: Co-op
coop.intro: Play with up to 3 friends. Create a room and share the code, or type a friend's code.
coop.startWait: Waiting for everyone to be ready…
coop.waitHost: Waiting for the host to start…
coop.off: Co-op is turned off right now.
coop.notSetUp: Co-op is not set up on this server yet.
coop.err.full: Co-op is full (the room has 4 players, or the free co-op allowance is used up today — it resets at 07:00 Thai time).
coop.err.started: That room's Run has already started.
coop.err.taken: That code is in use — try again.
coop.err.host-left: The host left, so the room closed. You keep what you collected.
coop.voteWait: Vote sent — waiting for the others…
coop.teamVotes: Voted: {who} · {left} s left (ties: the host's pick)
coop.downText: You are down. An ally can revive you by standing next to you for 3 s, or you get up at the next Chapter.
